name: switchbot
description: Control SwitchBot smart-home devices and scenes from Cursor via the SwitchBot CLI MCP server.

SWITCHBOT_OPENAPI_TOKEN.title: SwitchBot Open API token
SWITCHBOT_OPENAPI_TOKEN.description: From the SwitchBot app: Profile → Preferences → tap App Version 10 times → Developer Options → Token. Required for the MCP server.

SWITCHBOT_OPENAPI_SECRET.title: SwitchBot Open API secret
SWITCHBOT_OPENAPI_SECRET.description: Shown next to the token in Developer Options (Secret Key). If you already ran `switchbot auth login`, you can copy both from the CLI keychain/config instead of the app.
